title: Choosing the Dictionary and Penalty for IV-LASSO
abstract: arXiv:2609.07033v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating the first stage of an instrumental variables (IV) model with the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) requires choosing a dictionary of technical instruments and a penalty level. First-order asymptotic theory offers no guidance on these choices, as any consistent implementation yields a structural parameter estimator with the same limiting distribution. In finite samples, however, these choices can have a substantial impact on the resulting structural parameter estimate. Working in a model with a single endogenous regressor and homoskedastic Gaussian errors, we use first- and second-order Stein identities to derive the approximate mean squared error (AMSE) of the instrumental-variables LASSO (IV-LASSO) estimator, which can be consistently estimated and used to rank a prespecified list of dictionary-penalty candidates. The AMSE reveals a bias-variance trade-off: more complex first-stage fits better approx

translated_title: IV-LASSO的字典与惩罚参数选择
translated_abstract: 使用最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO）估计工具变量（IV）模型的第一阶段，需要选择一个技术性工具变量字典和惩罚水平。一阶渐近理论对这些选择无法提供指导，因为任何一致的实现所产生的结构参数估计量都具有相同的极限分布。然而，在有限样本中，这些选择可能对最终的结构参数估计产生实质性影响。我们在具有单一内生回归变量和同方差高斯误差的模型中，利用一阶和二阶Stein恒等式推导出工具变量LASSO（IV-LASSO）估计量的近似均方误差（AMSE），该误差可被一致地估计，并可用于对预先指定的字典-惩罚候选列表进行排序。AMSE揭示了一种偏差-方差权衡：更复杂的第一阶段拟合能更好地近似……
tldr: 本文利用一阶和二阶Stein恒等式推导出IV-LASSO估计量的近似均方误差（AMSE），为有限样本中选择工具变量字典和惩罚参数提供了可操作的依据。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the approximate mean squared error (AMSE) of the IV-LASSO estimator via first- and second-order Stein identities, enabling finite-sample selection of the instrument dictionary and penalty level.
